# miniz

miniz by Rich Geldreich, RAD Game Tools and Valve Software, release
[3.1.2](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/tag/3.1.2) (`miniz-3.1.2.zip`, the single-file `miniz.c` /
`miniz.h`, unchanged), MIT ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). Looks uses its zip reader to unpack the shader packs a player downloads
(`features/looks_packs.cpp`). `miniz_license.h` is the licence text for Settings > About.
